correctness.rationale: Parity is preserved by x²−2. For odd x the first iterate y satisfies y≡−1 (mod 8), and v2(f(y)+1)=v2(y+1)+1, producing exact pointwise time 1+max(0,k−v2(x²−1)) except x fixed. For x≡2 mod4, v2(f(x)−2)=v2(x²−4), after which each iterate increases distance-to-2 valuation by two; for x≡0 mod4, after two iterations the valuation is 2+2v2(x). These yield the two even pointwise branches. Four odd roots of unity modulo 2^s yield O0=1,O1=3,O_t=2^t for 2≤t≤k−2. The even valuation-window A_k and x≡0 mod4 count B_k exhaust and partition all even residues. Boundary moduli k=1,2 and special k=3,4 are separated explicitly; the infinity convention is harmless under modulus clipping. Fresh direct functional-graph iteration on every residue mod 2^k for k=1..12 (8,190 residues) agreed with the pointwise and even histogram formulas. Universal proof uses valuation identities, not a finite census.
residual_risks: Finite checks k≤12 are not an all-k proof.
